description: Set and read file-handling preferences: image previews saved with files (macOS icon and full-size previews, Mac and Windows thumbnails), the length of File > Open Recent, and the History Log (on or off, saved to the file's metadata or a text file, and its detail). Call with no settings to read them

historyLogFile.description: Absolute path of the text file the History Log is written to

historyLogSaveTo.description: Where the history log goes: the file's metadata (readable in File Info), a text file, or both

imagePreviews.description: Save image previews: always, never or ask when saving

recentFileListLength.description: Files listed in File > Open Recent

name: set_file_handling_preferences
title: Set File Handling Preferences
